agents.name: Name
agents.definitionFolderHint: The folder the agent reads itself from — not the folder it works in.

middle.wasOpen: This session was open when Clauding last closed. Click its row to resume it here.
middle.folderMissing: This session's folder is unknown or gone.
middle.folderMissingHint: Claude finds the conversation by its id, so it can be resumed in any folder you pick; its tools will then work in that folder.
middle.openingSilent: No terminal after 15 seconds: claude has not said anything.
transcript.empty: Pick a session on the left, or open a new terminal with + New.
panel.addressPlaceholder: Paste a file path or a URL and press Enter
panel.emptyHint: A local .html or .md file, or an http(s) address. Claude can open pages here too: ask for something “on the right”, or it runs `clauding open <path>` itself.
language.label: Language
header.pasteFileHint: Paste or drop a file: its path is typed into the terminal; Claude Code reads the file.
fork.tooltip: Start a copy of this conversation in a new terminal; this one stays as it is.
row.wasOpenHint: Open when Clauding last closed — click to resume it
row.deleteText: Delete this session and its transcript? This cannot be undone.
row.deleteFailed: This session could not be deleted: {message}
row.hideHint: {shortcut} — stops the session and puts it under Hidden
row.deleteHint: {shortcut} again, on the row under Hidden, deletes it
tags.deleteConfirm: Delete it? It comes off {count} sessions.
tags.limitNote: No room: three tags is the most a session wears ({count} left as they were).

newSession.title: New session
newSession.hint: A terminal running claude opens in this folder. The session appears in the list after your first message.
skills.title: Skills
skills.empty: No skills in this folder yet. Harvest skills from a conversation to write the first one.
settings.title: Settings
settings.agentsRootHint: Where “Create agent from this conversation” writes a new definition.
settings.skillsRootHint: Where Claude Code reads skills from. Shown here, changed there.
agents.assignText: From its next message on, this session follows the {name} definition ({folder}). The definition loads when the terminal is restarted or the session is resumed; the conversation is kept.
agents.unassignText: The conversation is kept; the definition stops applying at the next resume or restart.
flags.title: Extra claude flags
flags.globalHint: Added to every terminal, before the agent's and the session's own.
flags.agentHint: Added to every session this agent runs, e.g. --channels plugin:telegram@claude-plugins-official.
flags.sessionRestartText: Kept for this session and put back on every resume. Restarting starts claude again on the same conversation, this time with these flags; the conversation is kept.
flags.sessionResumeText: Kept for this session — it applies when you resume it here.
flags.tabHint: Tab fills in the suggestion; Escape clears the field.
meta.createAgentTooltip: Copy this conversation into a new terminal and let the Agent Maker distil it into an agent definition.
meta.harvestSkillsTooltip: Copy this conversation into a new terminal and run the skill-maker over it.
meta.waitForSession: Wait until the session has started — there is nothing to copy yet.
meta.noAgentMaker: The Agent Maker is missing. Restore it from the “…” menu of an agent in the Agents tab.
reader.backHint: Hide this page and go back to the terminal (Esc)
reader.copyPath: Click to copy the folder path
agents.noDefinitionFile: This agent has no definition file to read.
skills.scanHint: One main skills folder, but skills turn up all over a Mac. Pick the ones that really are skills; each is copied into your skills folder.
skills.scanEmpty: Nothing else found. Add another place to look, or scan again.
skills.scanOverwrite: Already in your skills folder: {names}. Replace them?
find.noTranscript: No transcript file for this session yet.
find.truncated: The rest of this message is not shown — it is longer than 20 kB.
projects.emptyList: No projects yet. A project follows some work: a ClickUp list if you have one, your git repositories, and the sessions that work on it.
projects.fieldRepositories: Local repositories, one folder per line
projects.fixtureReadOnly: This run shows the projects of CLAUDING_PROJECTS_FIXTURE; nothing can be added.
projects.refreshHint: Ask ClickUp, git (fetch) and GitHub again. Nothing is written anywhere.

projects.loadFailed: The project could not be read.
projects.noTokenTitle: No ClickUp token on this Mac
projects.tokenHowTo: Clauding reads ClickUp with your personal API token. Put it in the macOS Keychain:
projects.tokenEnvironment: …or start Clauding with CLAUDING_CLICKUP_TOKEN set. Then press Refresh.
projects.tokenReadOnly: The token stays in memory, is never written to disk, and is only used to read.
projects.noListTitle: This project has no ClickUp list yet
projects.noListText: Pick the build list in the project's settings (ClickUp → Change…).
projects.noTasks: The list has no tasks yet.
projects.buildListHint: The ClickUp list the work is tracked in
projects.planningListHint: The ClickUp list the specs are planned in
projects.repositoriesHint: Local repositories searched for CU- branches
projects.computedHint: A suggestion worked out from the open tasks and the work days left — not a goal anyone set.
projects.paceLine: To make {label}: {tasks} tasks in my queue, {days} work days → about {range} a day
projects.upNextEmpty: Nothing pinned to Up next yet — pin a task from its card's “…” menu.
projects.notStartedHidden: {count} tasks nobody has started — show them
projects.buildAfterSpec: starts when the spec is approved
projects.openTaskHint: Read the task here, in the side panel
projects.branchHint: A CU- branch in your checkout (read-only)
projects.noSessionsLinked: No session is linked to this task.
projects.noBranches: No CU- branch in the repositories yet.
clickupTab.notFound: This task is not in the project's data.
clickupTab.loadFailed: The task could not be read: {message}
clickupTab.readOnly: Read from ClickUp, never written. Comments and changes happen in ClickUp itself.
projects.fieldProjectLink: Project link (ClickUp list, folder or space)
projects.fieldProjectLinkHint: Paste the link from ClickUp's address bar. With a folder or a space, Clauding finds the build list and the specs list through the tasks' dependencies. ClickUp is only read.
projects.fieldTaskLinkHint: Settles which list is the build list when a folder or space holds several; alone, it is enough too.
projects.pickBuildList: Which list is the build list?
projects.pickBuildListHint: No task in these lists depends on another list's task, so Clauding does not guess. The specs list can be picked later in the settings.
projects.settingsLaterHint: Branches, people, deadlines and the status map are in the project's settings once it is added.
projects.linkError.notClickup: That is not a ClickUp link. Paste a link to a list, a folder, a space or a task.
projects.linkError.notTask: The second link is not a link to a ClickUp task.
projects.linkError.notFound: ClickUp says this does not exist, or your token cannot see it.
projects.linkError.noToken: No usable ClickUp token on this Mac — see the Projects section of the README.
projects.linkError.noLists: There is no list in that folder or space.
projects.linkError.viewWithoutList: That view does not belong to a list, folder or space.
projects.noDatesInClickup: None yet, and no dates in ClickUp yet: no task of this project has a due date or is a milestone.
projects.datesInClickup: None yet. In ClickUp, {dueDates} tasks have a due date and {milestones} are milestones — a deadline can follow one of them.
projects.deadlinesWithoutDates: {count} deadlines follow ClickUp tasks that have no due date yet.
projects.startSession: Start a session for this task
projects.noRepositoryToStart: Add a repository in the settings first
projectSettings.title: Project settings — {name}
projectSettings.readOnlyNote: Where the project reads from. Everything here is kept on this Mac; nothing is written back to ClickUp, git or GitHub.
projectSettings.countingHint: With subtasks counted, every subtask is a unit of work in the numbers, the queue, the pace and who has what; the cards stay one per task and list their subtasks either way. Closed tasks are the ones in a ClickUp status of the “closed” type; without them ClickUp is not asked for them at all.
projectSettings.noPlanningList: none — no build task depends on another list
projectSettings.listsHint: The specs list is found through the build tasks' “depends on”; pick it here when that chain is missing.
projectSettings.specField: Field that holds the spec link
projectSettings.specFieldHint: Matched by name, ignoring case; a field whose name starts with it counts too.
projectSettings.repositoriesHint: Branches named CU-<task id> are matched to tasks; “ahead” counts from the base branch on origin, “in staging” means merged into the staging branch on origin.
projectSettings.meHint: Used for “assigned to me”, the “Me” row and My focus.
projectSettings.deadlinesHint: A deadline can follow a ClickUp task's due date (it moves when the task moves) or be typed by hand.
projectSettings.noDatedTasks: No task of this project has a due date in ClickUp yet.
projectSettings.datedTasks: {count} tasks have a due date in ClickUp (listed first).
projectSettings.focus.recentSession: has a session that ran this week
projectSettings.upNextEmpty: Nothing pinned. Pin a task from its card's “…” menu.
projectSettings.upNextHint: The order here is the order of Up next. Only this Mac knows it; ClickUp is not touched.
projectSettings.buildStatuses: Build list statuses → my side · bucket
projectSettings.statusesHint: The names are ClickUp's own. “My side”: in my queue (I must act), waiting on others (staging, QA, feedback) or closed. “Automatic” is matched by the status's words and type; pick another place to change it for this project only.
projectSettings.clickupUnavailable: ClickUp could not be read right now; the statuses below come from the last copy on this Mac.
projectSettings.rolesHint: A session born from a spec agent fills the Spec row of a card, one from a builder the Build row.
projectSettings.noLinks: None — every link was found by the rules (branch, first message, transcript).
projectSettings.linksHint: Made from a card's “…” menu. ✕ forgets the choice and lets the rules decide again.
projectSettings.removeHint: Clauding forgets the project and its settings. Nothing in ClickUp, git or your sessions is touched.
projects.clickupError.notFound: ClickUp says this does not exist, or your token cannot see it.
projects.clickupError.rateLimited: ClickUp asked to slow down; try Refresh in a minute.
projects.clickupError.noToken: No ClickUp token on this Mac.
projects.handedOffToday: Handed off today: {count} (about {target} a day needed)
projects.handOffHint: Staging: your part is handed off here — the task waits on others, and can come back
projects.othersHint: Other people's step, shown for information
projectSettings.developerField: Drop-down field with the developer's own status
projectSettings.developerHint: Its value is shown on each card. A value set here places the task in my queue, waiting or closed whatever its ClickUp status says.
projects.deadlineSourceNote: From ClickUp: {name} ({count} dated, {undated} without a date)
projectSettings.deadlineSource: Where the phases and deadlines come from
projectSettings.deadlineIncludeManual: Also show the deadlines typed here
projectSettings.deadlineNoCandidates: Nothing in ClickUp looks like this project's plan: no milestone hangs under a task named for it, and no list of its space is named for a plan (roadmap, timeline, phases, releases).
projectSettings.deadlineManyCandidates: Several places could hold the plan: {names}. Pick one above.
projectSettings.deadlineSourceHint: Phases (a start and an end) are drawn as bars under the axis, single dates as markers on it. A click opens the task.
projects.paceLineWeekly: To make {label}: {tasks} tasks in my queue, {days} work days → about {range} a week
projects.handedOffTodayWeekly: Handed off today: {count} (about {target} a week needed)
projects.truncatedHint: The list is longer than the pages Clauding reads; the numbers count the tasks read.
projectSettings.deadlineSearchTruncated: (The workspace has more milestones than were searched; pick the place by hand if it is not listed.)
firstRun.title: Welcome to Clauding
firstRun.text: Clauding is a window around your Claude Code sessions. What differs from person to person — where Claude Code lives, your agents folder, your language, your projects — can be set up for you by an agent, one question at a time.
firstRun.agentText: Starts the Setup agent in a terminal. It checks what is on this Mac, asks about what it cannot find, and shows you a summary before it changes anything.
firstRun.myselfText: Opens Settings. Everything works with the defaults; you can add agents and projects whenever you like.
firstRun.note: You can start the Setup agent again at any time: Clauding ▸ Run setup agent… in the menu bar.
firstRun.noSetupAgent: The Setup agent is missing from the Agents tab. Use Restore built-in on the Agent Maker to bring it back.
projects.setUpText: The Setup agent puts the project together from what is there — a ClickUp list if you have one, your git repositories, and the sessions that worked on it — and shows you a draft before adding anything.
projects.setUpPlaceholder: A ClickUp link, a folder, or a few words (optional)
projects.setUpHint: Leave it empty and the agent will ask.
projects.noDatesGitOnly: None yet. This project has no ClickUp list, so its deadlines are the ones you add here.
projects.gitOnlyHint: This project has no ClickUp list: each feature branch of its repositories is a card, and its sessions are the ones on that branch.
projects.deadlinesAllHidden: All {count} deadlines are hidden. Show them again in Edit deadlines.
projectSettings.deadlineItemsHint: Uncheck a phase or date to leave it off the axis. The key deadline is what “Next” counts to; without one, it is the end of the phase that is running now.
